purpose: Teach: 可動/一団/電通/テコ/使節/敷設/全貌/国内線

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、可動式オフィス家具を導入しろ
lines.en: I want the company to introduce modular office furniture.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. No room for questions. Businesslike pace, each phrase distinct. Exhale finality on the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。若手社員を一団となって育成します
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop our junior staff as a cohesive unit.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight forward lean. Clear, measured delivery. Takes the directive as a mission. Steady confidence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、電通系の広告会社と提携しろ
lines.en: Partner the company with a Dentsu-affiliated advertising firm.
lines.style: Even, decisive tone. Sits back slightly — delegating now, not explaining. Brisk tempo. Final word lands with quiet authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資金繰りはテコ入れが必要です
lines.en: Understood. We'll need to leverage our cash flow situation.
lines.style: Professional, slightly concerned undertone. Tempo slows on the practical problem. Not complaining — proposing. Meets his gaze with quiet honesty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海外使節団を派遣する計画を立てろ
lines.en: Draft a plan to dispatch an overseas delegation.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Slight pause between clauses — each instruction hangs briefly. No inflection. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新オフィスのケーブル敷設を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll accelerate the cable installation in the new office.
lines.style: Quick acceptance. Efficient, no hesitation. Takes mental note and moves forward. Tempo slightly faster — demonstrating readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場の全貌を把握しろ
lines.en: Ensure the company gains a complete understanding of the market landscape.
lines.style: Final, comprehensive directive. Slower, weightier delivery. Each word carries equal emphasis. Finality suggests no follow-up needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国内線出張の経費を見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review the expenses for domestic business travel.
lines.style: Closing acknowledgment. Slight nod of the head. Tempo steady and calm. Brief, capable — the last word of the exchange. Understands this concludes the briefing.
